text: The subject is Usman Aslam, who holds account PK**UNIL****7198 opened on 25 November 2023. The subject declared an occupation as a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 220,000 per month. Between 3 July 2026 and 1 August 2026, the account recorded 18 credits totalling PKR 28,850,000 and 6 debits totalling PKR 21,636,000. The account received 17 cash deposits totalling PKR 28,630,000 across 3 branches (DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised by Tazama on 1 August 2026, where the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scored 320 against an alert threshold of 300. 15 of 17 cash deposits (88%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 27,270,000, which is just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, indicative of structuring. The cash deposits were spread across 3 branches (DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), a pattern consistent with suspected structuring. There was more than one cash deposit on 1 day (23 July 2026), which is indicative of structuring. Credits in the activity window were 131.1 times the declared monthly income of PKR 220,000 per month, a volume inconsistent with the declared income and consistent with suspected structuring. A note by Branch Operations on 16 July 2026 recorded that the customer asked why deposits of PKR 2 million or more need extra paperwork and declined to explain the source of the cash, behavior consistent with suspected structuring. The pattern of 15 of 17 cash deposits (88%) between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 27,270,000, across 3 branches (DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), just below the PKR 2,000,000 threshold, is consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 12,222,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank A) in 3 transactions. PKR 9,414,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank C) in 3 transactions. Debits equal to 75% of credits were made with a median of 26.4 hours between the latest credit and each debit. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 30 July 2026. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision.
